'''Veamon''' was a [[Color/Legends|gray]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] member of a blue-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Veamon's species|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that worked as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref> during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5]]<ref name="5-Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> and [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="10-Date">The opening crawl of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' states that the game's events take place five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II'' as taking place during the year [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Using simple addition, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' can be determined to take place during the year [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Veamon wore dark-colored [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], including a jacket with a red patch on the front-left side. Veamon also wore a large black [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] on the right shoulder. As a scout, Veamon carried weapons such as a [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar pistol]] and an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veamon first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|computer game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as a character who only appeared in the game's multiplayer addition as a playable character model.<ref name="Jedi" /> Veamon appeared again in ''Jedi Knight's'' [[1998]] expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. ''Mysteries of the Sith'' introduced "multiplayer personalities," a form of character creation that put different character models under different professions, with each profession having their own set of starting weapons for a match. In the game, Veamon was categorized as a scout.<ref name="Sith" />

Although Veamon had blue colored skin, the character model had light-colored [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. While all multiplayer player models shared a right hand due to the in-game models used for displaying a held weapon, Veamon's left hand was also light-skin colored. Whether or not Veamon had light-colored hands or if the character was merely wearing [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] cannot be definitively determined from the games.<ref name="Jedi" /><ref name="Sith" />
